releaseNotes: Migrate to Windows Graphics Capture (WGC) for ultra-smooth 60/120 FPS display and application window recording.
Implement a zero-allocation frame circular buffer pool to eliminate memory allocations and garbage collection overhead.
Establish automatic GPU encoder probing (NVENC, AMF, QSV) with standard software transcoding fallback.
Integrate parent process watcher threads using native Win32 wait handles for synchronized application exits.
Support UAC Secure Desktop pauses and single-instance instance locks over TCP loops.
